android.desc:
TRANSFORM REAL-WORLD TOUCHPOINTS INTO INTERACTIVE DIGITAL PORTALS
Create short-form interactive content portals that guide people from attention to action.

Netblitz is the discovery & experience layer, turning any touchpoint into living digital experiences people can discover, explore, and act on.

Combine video, images, audio, AR, and AI-generated content into story-driven portals that bring your content to life.

These portals open instantly through a scan or tap, connecting the physical world to guided digital journeys.

WHAT YOU CAN BUILD
• Guided storytelling portals: Create a front-and-back reveal, then sequence your content slide by slide, each one linking straight to a product, page, or next step
• AR experiences: Place digital content in the real world for your audience to discover and unlock the moment they're nearby
• Living brand and creator portals: Host AI chat agents, dynamic updates, rich media, launches, collections, portfolios that evolve as fast as you do, from a single bio page to a full event or content hub

TURN CONTENT INTO GUIDED DIGITAL EXPERIENCES
• Structure your story with carousels, slide-by-slide captions, and media galleries that guide your audience through a sequence, not just a scroll
• Pack your portal with video, images, audio, animations, and rich text — every media type in one immersive experience
• Embed AI-powered voice or chat agents to answer questions, guide visitors, and engage your audience automatically
• Add interactive elements like forms, reviews, calendars, booking links, and payment actions
• Connect your portals to your website, social media, store, or messaging apps
• Use flip-style layouts that make portals feel dynamic and alive

BRIDGE OFFLINE TO ONLINE MOMENTS
• Reach people offline at their moment of highest intent, when they're already curious and most open to discovering something new
• Take it further with AR: let your audience point their phone at any real-world location and watch your digital content come to life
• Connect products, packaging, business cards, menus, or any physical surface to an interactive portal
• Built-in QR code generator lets you instantly create QR codes or shareable links that open your portals anywhere

TRACK ENGAGEMENT AND CAPTURE LEADS
• Launch on-demand campaigns for releases, events, or collaborations
• Track views, clicks, and engagement in real time
• Capture and organize visitor contacts, with notes and easy follow-up

MOST PAGES
